findings.message: The sense gloss for kiśora, 'a colt; a youth, lad', joins two separate MW senses (mw-kishora.md, IDs 50640 and 50641). 'a colt' is not the sense used here.
findings.suggested_fix: Set sense.gloss to 'a youth, lad' (MW kiśora, BhP.), and optionally note that the word is used adjectivally as 'young'.
